p7_hero_subtitle: Signature wing doors meet relentless performance. Designed for your journey.
hero_feature_desc: Watch the P7 WING in motion and see its design from every angle.
p7_aerodynamics_desc1: Featuring signature electric scissor doors and an active rear spoiler, the P7 Wing generates high downforce at elevated speeds.
p7_aerodynamics_desc2: Its carbon fiber reinforced body panels and sculpted air ducts maximize high speed cornering stability while commanding attention on any road.
p7_awd_desc1: Powered by an advanced multi motor drivetrain, the P7 Wing delivers instantaneous launch acceleration and track calibrated handling.
p7_awd_desc2: Intelligent torque vectoring continuously monitors wheel slip to distribute power precisely where maximum grip is needed.
p7_cockpit_desc1: Step into a race inspired cockpit featuring lightweight carbon fiber bucket seats, an augmented reality HUD, and custom ambient lighting.
p7_cockpit_desc2: Premium Alcantara finishes and an immersive surround sound system create an unmatched fusion of high performance and luxury comfort.
tech_subtitle: Engineered without compromise. Pure electric power meets surgical precision handling.
exclusive_subtitle: Exclusive benefits designed for the early pioneers of the P7 Wing vision.
card_expo_desc: Experience the pinnacle of our P7 Wing debut series with exclusive trims and performance upgrades.
card_gala_desc: Unlock premium savings on weekly and weekend rentals of the P7 Wing.
card_seminar_desc: Seamless, rapid charging access for your P7 Wing rental at partner stations nationwide.
journey_subtitle: Experience the fusion of elegance and intelligence firsthand at your nearest experience center.
footer_desc: Defining the future of electric mobility through precision engineering and avant-garde design. Join us in the journey towards sustainable luxury.
